need: Let a turret or tower rise through a mansard roof with a 'pass through' option so the roof strip keeps cells above the eave inside the turret footprint, instead of leaving a pit or forcing a hand rebuild.
evidence: `mcd roof` on the turret footprint strips every roof cell above the eave; mansard preset always removes what is above the eave over the footprint; turret must be rebuilt after (turret-top.mjs).

need: Keep a multi-rectangle footprint as one unit so dormers land on the requested street face rather than the largest rectangle's inner face.
evidence: `--keep` re-splits footprint into rectangles; dormers land on largest rect's inner face (dormer dropped warning) rather than street face.

need: Accept the same front tokens as render (n|s|e|w) and fail with a clear message on invalid values instead of a TypeError.
evidence: `mcd roof --front` wants 'north' not 'n'; `--front n` crashed in dormersOn with an unhelpful TypeError.

need: Allow a tower-cap lucarne colour/wall to be set via options and let palette presets avoid exposed-copper orange brims.
evidence: Tower-cap preset gives no way to recolour lucarne except dormer:{wall}; copper palette ends in orange exposed-copper brim, so oxidized slabs were replaced by hand.

need: Window surround that follows a curved wall (round tower) without orphaned hood/sill ends hanging in air.
evidence: Round turret windows: surround assumes a flat wall; hood/sill ends hang in air beside curved tube; deleted by hand. Closest: surround plain.

need: Allow classical jambs to be spaced so windows closer than 4 apart do not merge into a solid wall, or provide a hood/sill/shutter trim option.
evidence: surround classical jambs are wall cells, so windows <4 apart merge into solid white wall; hand-written hood+sill+shutter trim used instead.

need: A fish-scale shingle brush that places stairs with the low step facing out over a wall region.
evidence: No fish-scale shingle brush: pink band is hand-placed stairs with low step facing out (loop over exterior cells). Closest: paint courses.

need: A deterministic fan or sunburst ornament brush for gable and pediment faces.
evidence: No sunburst/fan ornament brush: gold sunburst in porch gable is hand-placed bamboo and stairs.

need: Turned porch posts and spindle friezes as a brush with profile options beyond timber log posts.
evidence: Turned porch posts and spindle frieze hand-placed (fences, stair brackets). Closest: pilaster profile timber (log post, wrong look).

need: A chamfered or splayed bay brush that projects a faceted bay from a wall face.
evidence: Canted bay built from fills (3-wide front + 1-wide splays); closest setbacks.

need: Give gableRoof even-span gable-end decoration and a dormer-style window option for small hoods over bays or stoops.
evidence: Small gabled hood over bay and back stoop is gableRoof with no even-span gable-end decoration and no dormer-style window.

need: Allow planter ground to place leaves so hedges and flower beds are a single call.
evidence: planter ground refuses leaves, so hedge and flower beds are hand loops.

need: A curtain or interior-fill brush that gives transparent panes a back wall and floor so glazing does not show empty brown rooms.
evidence: Transparent panes show empty rooms (brown floors, ceilings); no curtain/interior-fill brush; hall back wall and pale floors hand-placed.

need: Palette outlier flags should not treat deliberate period accents (wood trim, corner boards, slabs) as stray; accept a per-style accent allowance.
evidence: palette outlier flags treat any non-blue/non-quartz accent (corner boards, wood deck, slabs) as stray; recoloured to stone bricks/quartz instead of period-accurate wood.

need: Render visible age and layered colour so the reviewer can see patina or mixed-block weathering; the review repeatedly asks for it but the look sheet may not show it.
evidence: Taste reviews v1-v3 all ask for visible age (patina, worn/mixed blocks) and fewer colour families; measured 10-11 visible materials, so reviewer-visible age may be under-rendered.
